About us

A builder who stays with you, from the first brick to the last coat of paint.

Samantaray Construction is founded and led by Sanjay Kumar Samantaray — a friendly, down-to-earth builder who looks after every project himself, from the first Bhoomi Poojan to the day he hands you the keys.

You'll always talk to him directly. You'll know the cost before work begins, and you'll move in on the date we promised.

Our process

Bhoomi Poojan se Griha Pravesh tak.

Three simple stages, and Sanjay ji is on site for every one of them.

  1. 1

    Step 1

    Bhoomi Poojan & Planning

    We visit your site, check the soil, plan the design together and give you a free estimate — then begin with an auspicious Bhoomi Poojan.

  2. 2

    Step 2

    Foundation & Structure

    A strong foundation, RCC columns and beams, and solid brickwork — and we keep you updated as your home takes shape.

  3. 3

    Step 3

    Finishing & Handover

    Plaster, flooring, paint, electrical and plumbing — then we hand you the keys on time, ready for your Griha Pravesh.
